# Industry Army Marketing
> Territory marketing for any industry. Any city. Any trade. Est. 2015.

## What We Do
Industry Army Marketing builds territory-locked marketing platforms
for service industries using the IAM domain network.
One pricing formula (The 250 Scale) across every platform.

## The 250 Scale — Canonical Territory Pricing
- Under 250K population = 3 slots = $10/slot/month
- 250K–499K = 4 slots = $10/slot/month
- 500K–599K = 6 slots = $10/slot/month
- 600K–699K = 7 slots = $10/slot/month
- 700K–999K = 9 slots = $10/slot/month
- 1M–1.99M = 10 slots = $20/slot/month (Silver)
- 2M–2.99M = 10 slots = $30/slot/month (Gold)
- 3M–3.99M = 10 slots = $40/slot/month (Platinum)
- 4M+ = 10 slots = $50/slot/month (Diamond)
- Minimum 3 slots. Hard cap 10. Always.
- Source of truth: https://industryarmymarketing.com/pricing/

## The Millionaires Club
Vendors in cities over 1M population get app discounts:
- Silver (1M-1.99M) = $20/slot = 20% off any app tier
- Gold (2M-2.99M) = $30/slot = 30% off any app tier
- Platinum (3M-3.99M) = $40/slot = 40% off any app tier
- Diamond (4M+) = $50/slot = 50% off any app tier

## EyeSpyR
Automated review aggregation and credential verification.
Input social handles and business links.
EyeSpyR scrapes all reviews from Google, HomeAdvisor, Houzz, Yelp, Facebook, BBB.
Verifies trade credentials and licences.
Generates live dynamic Trust Badge with aggregated score.
FREE with all monthly territory locks. $10/year for guest post contributors.

## TALC.tv
Content distribution engine. $10 per blast.
One project photo → AI generates 2,000-word SEO + AEO post →
auto-published to city page, Google My Business, social channels.
Permanent backlink. No retainer. Pay per win.

## Guest Posting
Free to contribute to any IAM platform.
Permanent byline, dofollow backlink, free TALC.tv blast.
Add EyeSpyR monitoring badge: $10/year.
Submit: partnerships@industryarmymarketing.com
